sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:77

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:77:1
items.html:
From the fifth hour of Erev Shabbat the worlds begin to rise etc. in the secret of the extra Hey etc. Explanation: the six days of creation are the secret of HGT NHY. Thus the sixth day, which is Yesod, is the one in which all five days, which are HGT NH, were sweetened and completed, which is the secret of “the sixth day. And the heavens were finished,” etc. This is why Yesod is called “all,” for it includes the five Sefirot HGT NH, as is known. And the sixth day itself is divided into twelve hours: the first six are the five Hassadim in Yesod, which are the sweetening of the five days HGT NH from the side of the Hassadim; thus the fifth hour is the discernment of Hod, and the sixth hour is its own discernment from the side of the Hassadim. And the last six hours are the sweetening of the five days HGT NH from the side of the Gevurot in them, and the sixth hour and twilight is its own discernment from the side of the Gevurot, which sweetens the five Gevurot HGT NH.
And the main sweetening falls on the fifth day, which is Hod, which is the Malchut that is close to the shells. And this is the secret of the extra Hey of the sixth day, which alludes to the fifth hour, which is the Hesed ascribed to the Sefira of Hod. Therefore, when the fifth hour arrives on the eve of Shabbat, the worlds begin to rise above their place, and holiness is added to them, for by then all five days HGT NH have already been sweetened from the side of the five Hassadim in Yesod. Hence there is an ascent for all the worlds above their place.
